claims: The Artemis II mission launched successfully on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launched at 2235 UTC.
The Artemis II mission launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission launched from Launch Pad 39B.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifted off from Launch Pad 39B.
The SLS rocket sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission duration was 10 days.
The Artemis II mission crew was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II launch was initially scheduled for 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II launch was pushed slightly to 6:35 p.m. EDT to accommodate final preparations and ensure all systems were ready.
